Name: Skell's Flowery Tools
Author: skellady
Description:
[center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/922475299369783336/1041451211976618024/Illustration.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[size=3]This mod retextures and recolors the tools to make them look softer + adds vines and flowers.[/size]

[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]

[size=3]1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url]2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]
3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex/mod managers)
4. Unzip the file and place the folder in your Mods folder

[size=4][b]See Also:

[/b][/size][size=3]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11105]Skell's Flowery Weapons[/url] to match the tools.[/size]
- My first tools mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8736]Slightly Recolored Tools[/url] if you'd like a version with softer/pastel tools without the vines and flowers.
[/size]
[size=4][b]Configuration:[/b][/size]

[size=3]This mod is highly configurable, which means you can use it alongside other weapons that retexture tools. To do that, I would highly recommend installing [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][size=3]Generic Mod Config Menu[/size][/url].
